proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.action
proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Spark is activated as a Magic action. The surface only supports `free` and `bonus_action`. The Magic action is one of the SRD's 12 standard action kinds and needs its own activation cost variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you point your Holy Symbol at another creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself and focus divine energy at it.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.choose_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The cleric chooses at use time between two mutually exclusive outcomes: heal HP or force a saving throw. The current `ClassFeatureEffect` union is a single-outcome type with no branching choice mechanism. A new variant like `{ kind: 'choose_effect'; choices: ReadonlyArray<ClassFeatureEffect> }` is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You either restore Hit Points to the creature equal to that total or force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.save_gate_damage
proposed_widenings.justification: The damage path of Divine Spark requires a CON saving throw against the cleric's spell save DC, with full damage on fail and half on success. No save-gated damage effect exists in `ClassFeatureEffect`. The spell tracer has a `save_gate` phase, but class features have no equivalent.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, the creature takes Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice) equal to that total. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage (round down).

proposed_widenings.name: DiceExpr.abilityModifier
proposed_widenings.justification: The amount rolled is 'Nd8 + Wisdom modifier'. The current `DiceExpr` has a fixed `flat?: number` field. An ability modifier is character-state-dependent and cannot be expressed as a compile-time constant. A new field `abilityModifier?: Ability` (or a parallel `DiceExprTerm` union) is needed to express modifier addends.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Roll 1d8 and add your Wisdom modifier.

proposed_widenings.name: DamageType choice-at-use-time
proposed_widenings.justification: The cleric chooses Necrotic or Radiant damage at the moment of use, not at authoring time. `DamageType` is a closed literal union with no 'choose from' mechanism. A new surface shape like `DamageTypeSelection = DamageType | { kind: 'choose'; options: ReadonlyArray<DamageType> }` is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature takes Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice)

notes: The Channel Divinity resource itself (use_count with threshold-tiered cap 2@L2/3@L6/4@L18, partial_short_full_long reset) fits the existing surface cleanly. The die-count scaling (1d8 → 4d8 via threshold_tiers at class levels 7/13/18) also fits as `scale_die_count`. The unit cannot be authored because (1) its activation cost is a Magic action (not representable), (2) its effect is a user choice between heal and save-gate-damage (not representable), (3) the amount formula includes an ability modifier addend (not representable), and (4) the damage type is chosen at use time (not representable). Encoding even the partial structure would require four surface widenings simultaneously. The heading 'Divine Spark' is embedded within the 'Level 2: Channel Divinity' section in the SRD markdown — the extract-unit-text tool could not find it as a standalone heading.
